name: tensile_tester
description: Universal testing machine, Excel export (testXpert style): sheets Parameters, Results, Statistics, then one sheet per test named after the specimen (sample name, three header rows: name, column names, units). Lap shear (EN 2243-1): Strain in mm, Shearing stress in MPa. Tensile (ASTM D 638): Elongation in %, 'Standard force' in kPa (a stress). A workbook may hold several tests; each is a curve named after its sheet. The test date comes from the specimen's row in the Results sheet; that sheet (one row per specimen: strength, modulus, dimensions, ...) is kept as the metadata table 'results'.
